title: ChannelForge Channel Alias Rules
description: Shape contract for data/rules/aliases.json (see Resolve-ChannelForgeAlias.ps1). This validates structure only. It does not check for duplicate aliases across entries or conflicting canonicals — those are semantic/cross-entry checks deferred for later, not shape checks.

_comment.description: Optional documentation note. Ignored by Resolve-ChannelForgeAlias.

canonical.description: The preferred/canonical channel name this entry resolves to.

aliases.description: Known alternate names that resolve to the canonical name. Conventionally includes the canonical name itself.
